runtime_rule: First independently audit the exact accepted current-capacity bridge and complete paid comparison/source/intake chain. No source regeneration or accepted paid execution.

Only settled comparison exposes windows/operands/costs. Restore predebit snapshots from exact accepted intake, bind their hashes and native rows/nominees to settled comparison. Recheck current snapshots differ only in wallet; current wallet must equal capacity bridge.

For every declared request window retain every canonical 33/workflow 32 cell, including empty/ineligible cells, and every native-ordered operand bundle examined within the unchanged alternatives bound. Preserve sentinel/deferred flags and exact per-window native nominees; no unbounded/unknown role coverage.

Reuse accepted native bounded operand expansion; strip only descriptive reason text from native proposal values, retaining exact proposal values. No factoring of content, recipes, operands, costs or nominees across windows.

Cross each exact option with retained/ordinary/n/cp/support means in existing TD5 order. Exact total estimates are native effort plus per-mean overhead plus current unpaid preparation energy/time. All terms remain visible even when structurally ineligible. Native effort is an estimate, not executed cost. Support additionally requires a native social recipe.

Reject work in priority order for ineligible mean, ineligible native proposal, non-integer/negative effort, invalid social recipe, or insufficient current wallet. Add one zero-cost defer candidate. Diagnostic nominee minimizes priority,time,energy,stable identity; identity includes window,cell,operand ordinal,bundle and mean.

No native command, reserve event, history credit, changed demand, refill, forced tie, old-label override or execution authority. No selected work is executed. Complete-domain claim is only within exact paid current window/operand grammar.
independent_audit: Imports neither new builder nor participant selectors. Reconstruct snapshots from owned view/journal, native rows via independent references, operand grammar via existing independent reference_bundles, and every new candidate/cost/priority/nominee independently. Full typed output equality, current capacity audit and exact native unchanged check mandatory.

execution.rule: Fresh exclusive output/init; disjoint per-record and per-method logs/targets. All 40 record reports before actual methods; all 8 exact methods before finish. Stop new launches on first failure, STOP, deadline or lease/owner change; wait existing children without signalling. Never rerun passing stages. Preserve failures/interrupted raw; existing raw without report may resume exact audit only after documented diagnosis. Failed bodies require prospective correction; no automatic retry.

claim_boundary: Read-only current TD5/estimated-cost diagnostic join across complete accepted window and bounded operand grammar only. Not full future role/skill coverage, actual preparation, live history-only choice, chosen movement/use, matched controls or parent FT7/FT8/FT9 acceptance.
